title: Generic boss
text: Each preset with its own weapons, against a level 63 boss with no creature type. Weapon racials count when the preset already holds that weapon type in either hand.

title: Beast target
text: A Beast boss turns on Troll Beast Slaying and Dwarf Big Game Hunter (5% more damage).

title: Elemental target
text: An Elemental boss turns on High Order and Windshaper Elemental Insight (5% more damage).

title: Humanoid target
text: Priests only. Dwarf Priests cast Chastise, which works only on Humanoids. No other racial cares about Humanoids.

title: Racial weapon
text: Human, Dwarf and Orc get their racial weapon type (sword, mace, axe) when the class can use it and the preset has none. We swap one weapon, the one whose speed changes least (the off hand on a tie). Dagger Rogues keep the main hand dagger. The new weapon keeps the stats and DPS, at the speed of the nearest Phase 1 BiS weapon of that type. Casters move the staff's stats to a one-hand weapon.

title: Racials off
text: Every race on its base stats, with all racials left out.

title: The Human Spirit
text: Spirit increased by 5%.
short: Spirit increased by 5%.

title: Sword Specialization
text: +2% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks while a sword is equipped.
short: +2% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks while a sword is equipped.

title: Mace Specialization
text: +1% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks while a mace is equipped.
short: +1% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks while a mace is equipped.

title: Axe Specialization
text: +1% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks while an axe is equipped.
short: +1% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks while an axe is equipped.

title: Elune's Light
text: +10% critical strike chance for 15 sec, 3 min cooldown.
short: +10% critical strike chance for 15 sec, 3 min cooldown.

title: Expansive Mind
text: Maximum Mana, Rage or Energy increased by 5%.
short: Maximum Mana, Rage or Energy increased by 5%.

title: Eureka!
text: The next 3 damaging abilities cost 10% less and deal 10% more damage, 2 min cooldown.
short: The next 3 damaging abilities cost 10% less and deal 10% more damage, 2 min cooldown.

title: Blood Fury
text: Attack power and spell power increased by 10% for 15 sec, 2 min cooldown.
short: Attack power and spell power increased by 10% for 15 sec, 2 min cooldown.

title: Touch of the Grave
text: Spells and attacks have a 5% chance (10% for Mages, Priests and Warlocks) to deal Shadow damage equal to 5% of your maximum health and heal you for it. At most once a second, and it cannot crit.
short: 5% chance a hit (10% for Mages, Priests and Warlocks) to deal Shadow damage equal to 5% of max health. At most once a second.

title: Endurance
text: Health increased by 5% and chance to hit increased by 1%.
short: Health increased by 5% and chance to hit increased by 1%.

title: Berserking
text: Attack and casting speed increased by 10% for 10 sec, 3 min cooldown.
short: Attack and casting speed increased by 10% for 10 sec, 3 min cooldown.

title: Wind Blessed
text: Spellcasting, melee and ranged haste increased by 1%.
short: Spellcasting, melee and ranged haste increased by 1%.

title: Big Game Hunter
text: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.
short: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

title: Beast Slaying
text: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.
short: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

title: Elemental Insight
text: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.
short: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

title: Chastise
text: Dwarf Priests: an instant Holy hit on a Humanoid, 2 min cooldown.
short: Dwarf Priests: an instant Holy hit on a Humanoid, 2 min cooldown.

title: Starshards
text: Night Elf Priests: Arcane damage over 6 sec, 30 sec cooldown.
short: Night Elf Priests: Arcane damage over 6 sec, 30 sec cooldown.

title: Dark Sacrifice
text: Undead Priests: trade health for mana over 15 sec, 10 min cooldown.
short: Undead Priests: trade health for mana over 15 sec, 10 min cooldown.

title: Base stats
text: The race's own Strength, Agility, Stamina, Intellect and Spirit, with no racials.
short: The race's own Strength, Agility, Stamina, Intellect and Spirit, with no racials.

title: Weapon swap
text: A weapon racial works only while either hand holds its weapon type. For a preset with another type, we swap one weapon to the racial's type, with the same stats and DPS, at the speed of the nearest Phase 1 BiS weapon of that type. This piece is what the new weapon changes by itself, before the racial: its speed, and talents with a bonus per weapon type.
short: What the racial's weapon type changes by itself, before the racial: its speed, and talents with a bonus per weapon type.

title: Target type
text: What this creature type changes: racials, talents and spells that work only on some types.
short: What this creature type changes: racials, talents and spells that work only on some types.

title: Warrior
text: Undead is best on Fury. Orc is best on Arms and Fury 2H. The best Alliance race on Fury is Human, 1.1% behind. Undead Touch of the Grave is the biggest racial on Fury, +32.5 DPS (3.0%). With a sword, Human comes within 0.8% on Arms. Against Beasts, Troll leads Fury (+5.2% vs the generic boss), 1.0% ahead of Dwarf. Against Elementals, High Order and Windshaper lead Fury (+5.2% vs the generic boss), 2.6% ahead of Undead.

title: Rogue
text: Undead is best on every Rogue preset. Orc is next, 0.1% behind on Combat Swords. The best Alliance race on Combat Swords is Night Elf, 1.8% behind. Undead Touch of the Grave is the biggest racial on Combat Swords, +18.7 DPS (2.6%). With a sword, Human comes within 1.2% on Combat Swords. Against Beasts, Troll leads Combat Swords (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 0.9% ahead of Dwarf. Against Elementals, High Order and Windshaper lead Combat Swords (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 2.9% ahead of Undead.

title: Hunter
text: Night Elf is best on Lone Wolf, Marksmanship and Beast Mastery. Orc is best on Survival. Orc Blood Fury is the biggest racial on Lone Wolf, +14.9 DPS (1.4%). With an axe, Orc comes within 0.2% on Beast Mastery. Against Beasts, Troll leads Lone Wolf (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 1.0% ahead of Dwarf. Against Elementals, High Order and Windshaper lead Lone Wolf (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 4.0% ahead of Night Elf.

title: Paladin
text: Undead is best on every Paladin preset. Human is next, 1.5% behind on Ret twist. Undead Touch of the Grave is the biggest racial on Ret twist, +14.9 DPS (1.5%). With a sword, Human ties for the lead on Ret twist. Against Beasts, Dwarf leads Ret twist (+4.0% vs the generic boss), 2.3% ahead of Undead.

title: Shaman
text: Orc is best on every Shaman preset. Windshaper is next, 1.7% behind on Enhancement. The best Alliance race on Enhancement is Dwarf, 2.3% behind. Orc Blood Fury is the biggest racial on Enhancement, +10.5 DPS (1.3%). With an axe, Orc would lead Elemental Mana Tide by 0.8%. Against Beasts, Troll leads Enhancement (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 0.6% ahead of Dwarf. Against Elementals, Windshaper leads Enhancement (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 3.1% ahead of Orc.

title: Druid
text: Night Elf is best on every Druid preset. Tauren is next, 1.1% behind on Balance. Night Elf Elune's Light is the biggest racial on Balance, +8.8 DPS (1.1%). High Order Wind Blessed costs 6.1 DPS on Balance. Against Elementals, High Order and Windshaper lead Balance (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 3.0% ahead of Night Elf.

title: Mage
text: Orc is best on Frostfire. High Order is best on Frost. Undead is best on Fire and Arcane. The best Alliance race on Frostfire is Gnome, 0.1% behind. Undead Touch of the Grave is the biggest racial on Frostfire, +9.3 DPS (0.9%). High Order Wind Blessed costs 1.5 DPS on Arcane. With a sword, Human would lead Frostfire by 0.3%. Against Beasts, Troll leads Frostfire (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 4.0% ahead of Orc. Against Elementals, High Order leads Frostfire (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 4.5% ahead of Orc.

title: Warlock
text: Gnome is best on Demonology, Destruction and Affliction. Undead is best on Destruction Fire. Gnome Eureka! is the biggest racial on Demonology, +16.1 DPS (1.4%). With a sword, Human would lead Destruction by 0.4%. Against Beasts, Troll leads Demonology (+4.5% vs the generic boss), 2.8% ahead of Gnome.

title: Priest
text: Undead is best on every Priest preset. Gnome is next, 0.6% behind on Shadow. Undead Touch of the Grave is the biggest racial on Shadow, +15.5 DPS (1.8%). Undead Dark Sacrifice costs 5.0 DPS on Shadow + Holy, for the time spent casting it. With a mace, Dwarf comes within 0.5% on Shadow + Holy. Against Beasts, Dwarf leads Shadow (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 0.1% ahead of Troll.
